text: As the Patriots prepare for their Week 3 road trip to Jacksonville, the organization is clearly focused on operational refinement both in preparation and in-game management—the new mobile classroom at the New Balance Athletics Center represents one such innovation, though the team's late-game clock management before halftime remains a persistent concern that Bill Belichick's staff has acknowledged needs improvement. On the injury front, there's been modest good news with rookie tight end Eli Raridon returning to practice, while safety Dell Pettus has been placed on injured reserve and linebacker Jose Ramirez has been elevated from the practice squad to the 53-man roster, with linebacker Benton Whitley joining the practice squad in a corresponding move. Defensively, the Patriots are preparing to counter Jacksonville's expected Cover-6 looks by building their gameplan around 'X' plays, and they'll need to do so against a Jaguars offense looking to rebound after their worst performance in eleven months—though Trevor Lawrence's squad is feeling confident heading into the matchup with a Patriots team still searching for the offensive identity that fueled their Super Bowl season.
